coverage_note: The Banque d'Algérie agréé roster (21 banks + 8 financial institutions) is complete. Branch locations cover all 21 banks' own locators (1,704 branches); 1,221 carry a geocoded point, including eight reviewed BDL and SGA branches matched to OSM by bank, wilaya, locality, and agency number or street address. The rest remain address-only (see README).
